name: universal-research-memory
description: Codex-only provenance-first research memory, governed ingestion, and workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Codex research memory with governed workflows.
interface.longDescription: Universal Research provides source-grounded memory, recoverable governed ingestion, evidence-eligibility checks, and an eleven-role governance contract for Codex. Governed agent creation is default-deny until the user sees and explicitly approves an exact reason, task/count, direct alternative, token/time estimate, and scope disclosure. Model selection, native agent sessions, external model APIs, and tool execution remain owned by the Codex host.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Codex host-owned execution only. Before creating any agent, explain why it is needed, each delegated task, the count, direct-execution alternative, bounded additional token/time estimates, and exact scope; wait for the user's explicit approval of that exact disclosure. Otherwise work directly. Treat evidence eligibility as an integrity/range/count check, never proof of semantic support or truth. Keep canonical ingestion two-step and keep visualization off unless explicitly approved.
